name: AJ02
context_payload: Exactly header0x6300001d, base_index0, 28 consecutive immutable context words
The next command header must be JOB0x6400000b; ordinary state commands precede this context packet

mmio_words.0x21: status: active0 repair1 fault2 lease_pending3 lease_granted4 raw_success5 repair_word_ready6
mmio_words.0x23: completed_job_seq (all earlier generated words stored, not raster completed)
mmio_words.0x27: read repair_data (synchronous matrix selector; write selector then read)
mmio_words.0x28: write repair output word only when ready; requires matching acknowledgment token first
mmio_words.0x29: write active repair token before first DATA and END
mmio_words.0x2a: write1 END after all repair words; active raw alias burst drains before release
mmio_words.0x2b: write/read legacy requested-prefix sequence for diagnostics only; priority grant is independent of this value
mmio_words.0x2d: write1 priority acquire/write2 release; acquire only at complete current job/context boundary, retain matching ticket until materialized/drop barrier or progress wait

raw_view: Existing 0x13f80000 alias,32x8 words pervertex; only repair owner or granted legacy lease; discard CPU alias cache before each generation
ordering: CPU publishes complete immutable context/job before any wait.
Worker holds source/raw/context through successful full packet store or whole-task repair END.
Repair output streams at head directly into ordinary output FIFO, never ingress tail.
CPU may advance renderer only for cached eligible opaque material and proven dead canonical slots.
Source arena recycle waits completion of all submitted jobs.

GPU consumer reset discards coupled output, cancels/drains async DMA, increments epoch/token and clears async completion; granted legacy ticket/raw view and active legacy LOAD survive. Full fabric reset clears all.
Legacy and async context use shared registers/matrix; CPU refreshes dirty context after each ownership switch.
ACQUIRE is issued only when no lease is pending/granted; a matching retained ticket is already owned, so software must not reacquire it.
Source data and original CPU command pointers remain immutable through repair END or normal output completion.
Full matrix context must exist before JOB; invalid descriptors, stale DATA/END tokens and writes without credit fault visibly.
Every JOB requires all28 consecutive context words0..27, including after retained legacy context writes. No delta context.
ACQUIRE wins against the first accepted context word. After any context word is accepted, grant waits the matching JOB and all of its output/repair completion.
Priority legacy grant does not imply completion of older queued jobs. completed_job_seq remains the sole immutable-source completion fence.
Materialize all surviving lazy raw rows and release legacy ownership before ALL progress waits depending on queued jobs, including ring capacity, source recycle, GPU idle/fence, texture and DMA.
Consumer reset clears partial context and pending acquire, but preserves granted legacy ticket/raw alias and active legacy DMA.
resources: Reuse4096word ingress, one512word common output(2M10K), existing survivor1M10K, existing raw/FMA. No separate packet queue.
